next_steps_operator_required: 1. CALL Hartwig Inc (IL Okuma distributor) or Morris Midwest — get Okuma Service Portal credentials for JM Die serial numbers. Unlocks 8 of 15 machines.
2. CALL Okuma America 1-704-588-7000 if distributor stalls — they will email PDFs for verified serials.
3. CALL MC Machinery Systems — get customer portal account for JM Die. Unlocks 3 EDM machines.
4. CALL Methods Machine Tools — request Roku-Roku HC 658-II spec sheet + Fanuc 31i-B5 op manual reference.
5. ON-MACHINE: For each Okuma, plug FAT32 USB stick into OSP, navigate Program -> File Maintenance -> USB, copy C:\OSP\HELP\ or D:\OSP\MANUAL\ to stick. No password needed.
